Package io.vanslog.spring.data.meilisearch.core

Interface ReactiveSearchOperations

All Known Subinterfaces:
ReactiveMeilisearchOperations
All Known Implementing Classes:
ReactiveMeilisearchTemplate
public interface ReactiveSearchOperations
Cold, non-blocking search operations. Each publisher consumes a finite JSON response and preserves mapped hit metadata; it does not promise server-side streaming.

Junghoon Ban
